div.div: مَسْرَحٌ A place of pasturage: (K:) or a place into which beasts are sent forth, or sent forth in the morning, to pasture: (O:) pl. مَسَارِحُ. (TA.) لَهُ إِبِلٌ قَلِيلَاتُ المَسَارِحِ occurs in a trad., of UmmZara, meaning [He has camels whose places of pasturage are few; i. e.] his camels do not go forth into distant pasturage, but lie down in his outer court, or yard, in order that they may be near by to supply the guests with their milk and their flesh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
